scenario: Discussing a news story with a colleague
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: A cikin labarin fasaha, yana nufin reportaje ko informe.
Yana amfani da shi don magana game da wata matsala ko wasanni.
Mai yin bayani wanda ya fara bayyana wata yarda ko yarda mai yarda.
Dabam da farin ciki ko tasirin wani abu.
Yana nufin cinye ko yin ƙarfi.
Gunduma da ke jagoranta wata ƙasa.
Da ke danganci al'umma ko shugabanin ƙasa (ba na sassiya ba).
Adverb wanda yana nufin yarda.
Yana nufin kawo hukunci.
Yana nufin rashin goyiya.
Mai yin bayani wanda ya fara bayyana wata yarda ko yarda mai yarda.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you see the report about the new public transport plan?
dialogue.translation: Kun ganin wata labarin game da sabon tsarin fasaha na jama'a?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I read it. Although the government says it will help, many people are against it.
dialogue.translation: Ee, na karanta shi. Duk da haka, shugabanin ƙasa suka fada cewa zai taimaka, amma yara da yara ne da suke da rashin goyiya.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think the main issue is the cost. It might increase taxes, and that could have a big effect on the economy.
dialogue.translation: Ina tunawa matsalar ne da farashin. Zai iya cinye taxes, sannan wannan zai iya samun tasiri mai girma a kan kasuwanci.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Probably, but they say it will create more jobs. I'm not sure what they will decide.
dialogue.translation: Ya zama, amma suka fada cewa zai samar da yara da yara masu aiki. Ba zan tabbata ba wanda suka zama da shi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but if they cut other services, it will be a problem. The public might be more affected than they think.
dialogue.translation: Ee, amma idan suka rage sababbin fasaha, zai zama matsala. Jama'a zai iya samun tasiri mai girma da yadda suka yi tunanin.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let's wait and see. Although I'm a bit worried, I hope they make a good choice.
dialogue.translation: Bari mu jira da ganin. Duk da haka, ina da wahala sosai, amma na fatan su kawo wata zaɓi mai kyau.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, we can only hope. I'll check the news again tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: Ee, mun zama da fatan. Zan duba labaran nan da yaushe.

scenario: Negotiating a minor disagreement

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I don't agree with your plan to go to the beach, though.
dialogue.translation: Ba zan yarda da planninka zuwa yankin tebur, amma.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe we could change the time instead of changing the place.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, but I'm not sure it's the best matter to discuss right now.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Perhaps we should just decide together without arguing.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I agree, but I still think the plan has a problem, though.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe we can try a different plan, perhaps a picnic instead?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sure, that could work without any problem. Let's do that, though.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I’ve read your draft, but I haven’t finished the last section yet.
dialogue.translation: Na karanta rubutarku, amma ba zan kammala wata na ƙarshe ba tukuna.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That’s okay. The quality of the beginning is quite good, I think.
dialogue.translation: Yaushe. Qualiti na farko da yawa mai kyau ne, ina ganin.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I agree with that, though we need to improve the ending a lot.
dialogue.translation: Na yarda da wannan, amma muna bukata mu sanya da kyau da ƙarshe.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, the result is not strong enough. However, your ideas are clear.
dialogue.translation: Eh, nema ba da wata da yawa ba. Amma, kalubalenka suna da hankali.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks. What else should I consider for the final version?
dialogue.translation: Na gode. Wane ne wani abu zan iya bincika don sabon rubutu?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It’s possible to add more examples, and provide more evidence for your claims.
dialogue.translation: Ana iya ƙara misali da yawa, da kuma samar da dalilai da yawa don maganarku.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great, I’ll work on that. Can you support me with the data?
dialogue.translation: Maza, zan yi wannan. Ko zaka iya taya mini taimako da bayanai?

key_phrases.translation: Qualiti da yawa mai kyau ce

scenario: Explaining a problem to customer service
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I received my order yesterday, but the color is wrong.
dialogue.translation: Sannu, na samu odana jiya, amma irin wata ne mahaɗa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Could you send me a photo of the item you received?
dialogue.translation: Babu wata murna da nufi. Ko zaka iya aikowa ni hoton wata abu da ka samu?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll send it right away. Also, I need to return the item and get a refund.
dialogue.translation: Me, zan aiko shi da yaushe. Wani abu kuma, zan komawa wata abu da zan samu baya da kudi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. We will not charge you for the return. Please check your email for instructions.
dialogue.translation: Me, ba zan kama da kudi ba saboda komawa. Da fatan za ka duba wata adireshin email don umarni.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. How long will I have to wait for the refund?
dialogue.translation: Na gode. Wane yawanci zan iya jiran baya da kudi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Usually it takes 5–7 days. Please be careful with the return label we provide.
dialogue.translation: Yaushe ya yi tsawon 5-7 kwana. Da fatan ka kula da labarin komawa da muka ba ka.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great, I'll be careful. Thank you for solving my problem.
dialogue.translation: Murna, zan kula. Na gode saboda ka tattauna matsalata.

scenario: Talking about ambitions and career goals
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Yin daidaitawa ga matukar da fasaha ko ma'anarwa, da yawa da 'get'.
Yin daidaitawa da fasaha da aiki, ba da 'carrera universitaria'.
Ya daidaitawa ne, amma an yi nasara domin cika da yawa.

vocabulary.translation: ya da a kan, ya yi bukata

vocabulary.note: Da yawa na iya zama 'yawo zuwa'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I want to achieve a high position in my career, but I know it will require a lot of effort.
dialogue.translation: Ina son in samu matsayi mai girma a cikin kasuwarkina, amma na san cewa zai yi bukata da yawa da juriya.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a great goal. What kind of role would you like to reach in the future?
dialogue.translation: Wannan meta mai girma ce. Wane irin waje za ka samu a baya?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'd love to lead a team someday, but I think I need more experience first.
dialogue.translation: Ina son in dore wata 'ya'yan aiki wata rana, amma na tsammanin zan bukata da sabon fasaha da farko.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe you can find an opportunity to manage a small project at work.
dialogue.translation: Maybe za ka samu damar ya yi wani sabon fasaha a cikin aiki.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I hope so. Success doesn't come overnight, so I'll continue studying and improving my skills.
dialogue.translation: Ina fatan cewa haka. Nasara ba ta zo da rai, saboda haka zan ci gaba da koyo da siyasa da fasaharku.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's the right attitude. I'm sure you'll achieve everything you set your mind to.
dialogue.translation: Wannan ra'ayi ne mai kyau. Na tabbata za ka samu duk abin da ka tsammanin.

key_phrases.translation: nasara ba ta zo da rai

scenario: Discussing health habits and lifestyle
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.translation: da yaushe, da yaushe da yaushe
vocabulary.note: Yanayin yaushe a cikin halaye.
Yanayin jiki na fashe.
Zai iya zama suna, amma a nan an yi shi a matsayin jimawa.
Yanayin lafiya da mai ban sha'awa.
Damuwa don yin wani abu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I try to exercise in the morning, but I don't do it often.
dialogue.translation: Ina son yin motsa jiki da safe, amma ba zan yi shi da yaushe ba.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's okay. The important thing is to listen to your body and find a routine that works for you.
dialogue.translation: Wannan da yake. Abin da ya fi muhimmi ne shine ganin jikin ku da kuma neman wasanni da zai dace da ku.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I know. I feel much better when I have more energy during the day.
dialogue.translation: Na sani. Ina jin mai kyau da yaushe in da na sami damuwa da yaushe a rana.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, and sleep is a key part of that. Do you sleep at least seven hours?
dialogue.translation: Ee, da huta kuma wani abu ne mai muhimmi. Shin kun huta kamar shekaru bakwai?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Usually, yes. But my main problem is stress, not sleep.
dialogue.translation: Yaushe, ee. Amma matsalolin da na ci gaba shine matsala, ba huta ba.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Stress can affect your health a lot. Maybe you need a new habit to relax, like reading or walking.
dialogue.translation: Matsala zai iya fa'ida da lafiya da yaushe. Maybe kuna bukata wa wani halaye saboda jin damuwa, kamar karatu ko tafiya.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, because I want to feel healthier overall.
dialogue.translation: Wannan wata idea mai kyau ne, saboda inan jin mai lafiya a cikin dukan halaye.

key_phrases.translation: jin mai lafiya a cikin dukan halaye

scenario: Talking about environmental issues
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Yana nufin wani abu ya faruwa wata hali, ko mafi yawan hali da yawa.

Yana nufin wani abu da yawa ko wanda ke da alamu.
Yana nufin wani abu kawai, kamar 'single-use' (wata daya kawai).
Yana nufin wata yuwuwar. Ana amfani da shi kamar adverb a cikin jumla.
Yana nufin wata matsala mai girma ko mai muhimmanci.

A ƙarshe na jumla yana nufin 'dukiya'. A fuskar jumla yana nufin 'amma'.
Yana nufin tsaki da wani abu ko yin tsaki da wani abu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think plastic waste is a serious problem, but people still use too much of it.
dialogue.translation: Ina ganin cewa wasu abubuwan da suka zama a cikin dajin yanayi suna murna, amma mutane suna amfani da su da yawa har yanzu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.yes: I know. A common mistake is using single plastic bags for everything.
dialogue.translation: Na san. Wata matsala mahal ita ce amfani da kayan aji na daya kawai don kowane abu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. That habit can cause a lot of damage to the environment over time.
dialogue.translation: Da yaushe. Wannan halin ya iya sanya wata murna mai yawa ga dajin yanayi a over time.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, what is the best action we can take to reduce our impact?
dialogue.translation: To, me ne wata hanyar da za mu iya yin ta don sake yanke tasirin mu?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well, using a reusable bottle is a simple step. And it's likely to become a habit quickly.
dialogue.translation: Yaushe, amfani da wasu jerin da za a iya amfani da shi da yawa yana da wata hanyar da za a iya ci gaba da ita da yawa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That makes sense. I'm not against small changes, though. Every little bit helps.
dialogue.translation: Wannan ya dace. Ba zan tsaki da canje-canje mai yawa ba, dukiya. Kowane abu mai yawa yana taimaka.

key_phrases.translation: wasu abubuwan da suka zama a cikin dajin yanayi
Kowane abu mai yawa yana taimaka

scenario: Discussing a decision you had to make
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Verbo mai matsa: zaɓi, zaɓa, zaɓi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I had to choose between two job offers last week.
dialogue.translation: Na iya zaɓi tsakanin biyu na sabis na wata mako da yaushe.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a tough decision. What options did you weigh?
dialogue.translation: Wannan shawara mai wahala ce. Me zaɓi ne ka duba da yawa?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I considered the salary and the commute, but the risk of moving to a new city was a big factor.
dialogue.translation: Na bincike da yawa fasara da sabis, amma matsalolin motsa jiki zuwa sabon birni na wani sabon abu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Were you certain about the outcome of each option?
dialogue.translation: Kun da yawa ne kake tabbata game da sauke na karshe na dukkan zaɓi?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Not fully, although I knew the salary was higher in the second job.
dialogue.translation: Ba da yawa ba, duk da haka na sani cewa fasara ta fi girma a cikin sabis na biyu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, what did you finally decide?
dialogue.translation: To, me ne kaka shawara karshe?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I chose the first job, rather than the second, due to the shorter commute and better work-life balance.
dialogue.translation: Na zaɓi sabis na farko, ko kwarai sabis na biyu, saboda motsa jiki mai yawa da kyakkyawan tsarin rayuwarsa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've changed my mind about the trip to the beach this weekend.
dialogue.translation: Na canza hankalina game da sabon da zai zo wajen yaushe.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Really? Why? You seemed so excited about it before.
dialogue.translation: Da yaushe? Me ya sa? Kafin kake da murna da shi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well, I realized that the weather forecast is bad, and actually, I have a lot of work to do.
dialogue.translation: To, na sanya hankalina cewa fasaha ta yi mugu, da kuma da yaushe, ina da aiki da yawa da yi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But you had a plan to relax and enjoy the sun!
dialogue.translation: Amma kana da shirya don jin daɗe da samun haske!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but I realized that it's not possible to finish my project if I go. Since the deadline is Monday, I need to stay home.
dialogue.translation: Eh, amma na sanya hankalina cewa ba zan iya cika aikin ba idan na tafi. Saboda matsayin kwanaki ya zama Litinin, ina buƙatar zama gida.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a fact. But you could work in the morning and go later, instead of canceling everything.
dialogue.translation: Wannan gaskiya ce. Amma zaka iya aiki a dafe da zuwa da ƙarfe, a wata abu, ba a cire duk abu ba.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, though I need to see if my friend can support me with the ride. Thanks for the advice!
dialogue.translation: Wannan wata murna ce, amma ina buƙatar duba idan abokaina zai iya taya damar da ni. Na gode saboda shawara!

scenario: Talking about cultural differences
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Yana nufin al’adun, fasaha da fasaha na mutane.
Wata fasaha mai tasiri da wani yankin.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I find it interesting how many cultural differences there are between countries.
dialogue.translation: Ya yi banza yadda akwai manyan fasada da al’adu a tsakanin kasashe.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, even something like greeting can be a custom that changes the behavior of people.
dialogue.translation: Haka ne, ko wata abu kamar yabon mai haske zai zama wata al’ada da ta canza yadda mutane suke nuna fasaha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: For example, in my culture, it's rude to eat with your hands, but in some places it's completely polite.
dialogue.translation: Misali, a al’aduna, ya zama mai yatsu da yin cin abinci da hannu, amma a wani wuri, ya zama mai haske da yin haka.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I usually expect people to follow local customs, but I try to respect different ones.
dialogue.translation: Ina da dogara da cewa mutane suka bi al’adun nan gaba, amma ina son yarda da fasada da suka yi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's good. I think many customs are similar in essence, just expressed differently.
dialogue.translation: Wannan da yake da kyau. Ina tsammanin manyan al’adun suka da wani irin fasada, kawai suka nuna da yadda suka yi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, the key is to be open and learn about the differences between us.
dialogue.translation: Saboda haka, matsayin mu ne mu kasance mai fahimtar da mu koyi game da fasada da ke tsakaninmu.

key_phrases.translation: yarda da fasada da suka yi

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need to connect my new phone to the Wi-Fi, but I can't find the settings.
dialogue.translation: Ina buƙatar connectar wayar sabuwar da na da layi, amma ba zan samu saitin ba.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's simple. Just go to the settings app and look for the Wi-Fi option.
dialogue.translation: Wannan mai sauki ne. Yi nasara zuwa app na saitin kuma nemi zaɓi na layi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh, I see. But I also want to download a new messenger app to message my friends.
dialogue.translation: Ah, na gane. Amma zan yi download app sabuwar mai message don rubuta wa abokai.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's useful, but check the battery first. Downloading can use a lot of energy.
dialogue.translation: Wannan da yiwuwa ne, amma duba batiri da farko. Download zai yi amfani da ƙarfi mai yawa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. And what about the screen? Sometimes it stays on too long.
dialogue.translation: Ka yi hakka. Da yaushe ne da filin allo? Kwanaki da yawa yana da allo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You can change that in the settings, too. Also, as a user, you should share your location with friends only if you trust them.
dialogue.translation: Zaka iya canza wannan a cikin saitin. Kuma, kamar mai amfani, ya kamata ka share da matsayin kuɗi ne kawai idan ka yarda da su.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks! Now I feel more comfortable using my device online.
dialogue.translation: Na gode! Yanzu na jin damuwa da amfani da wake na a layi.

scenario: At a formal meeting giving your opinion
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ya zai yi amfani da shi a cikin fasaha don nuna wata ra'ayi.
A cikin fasahin da ke da tsaro, yana nufin wata matsala ko wasanni da za a tattauna.
Ya zai yi amfani don nuna wata argument ko fasaha.
Verb mai daidaitawa da aka yi amfani da shi don nuna cewa wani abu ya dace.

vocabulary.translation: ba da shawara, ba da shawara mai fasaha
vocabulary.note: Ya zai yi amfani don ba da wata fasaha ko aiki a cikin fasaha.
Ya zai yi amfani don nuna cewa wani abu ya zama mai muhawara kafin a yarda da shi.
Wani abu da ya nuna wata farin ciki a cikin fasahin mai tsaro.
Wani abu da ya nuna wata zakara mai fasaha.
Mai fasaha da kwarewa don nuna wata imani.
Ya zai yi amfani don nuna wata fasaha ko bayanai.
Wani abu da ya nuna wata sabon bayani a cikin fasahin.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: In my view, the main issue is the budget for the project.
dialogue.translation: Da fasahata, matsalolin da ke da muni shine bugetin da ke dangane da aikin.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I see your point, however, I think we should consider the timeline first.
dialogue.translation: Na gane yankinka, duka dai, na yi tunani cewa ya kamata mu bincika sabon lokaci da farko.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That is a valid point. Therefore, perhaps we can discuss both together.
dialogue.translation: Wannan yanki ne mai fasaha. Saboda haka, wataƙila za mu tattauna biyu tare.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I agree with that. In addition, we could ask for more data from the team.
dialogue.translation: Na fatanawa da wannan. Kuma, za mu iya tambaya saboda bayanai daga taron.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good idea. According to the latest report, we have some flexibility.
dialogue.translation: Wata fasaha ce. Bisa ga sabon rahoton, muna da wata sabon fasaha.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Then I suggest we prepare a proposal with both options.
dialogue.translation: Saboda haka na ba da shawara mu shirya wata shawarar tare da biyu na yanzu.

scenario: Describing a person's character in depth
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Yar da ake amfani da shi don nuna wani mutum wanda ya yi gaskiya.
Yar da ake amfani da shi don nuna wani mutum wanda ya tsallake matsala ba tare da tsoro ba.
Wani mutum wanda ya ba da komai ba tare da ganin samun wata abu a can.
Wanda ya iya jira ba tare da jin hasara ba.
Mutum wanda ya jin tsoro ko murna da wata mutum wanda ba ya sani ba.
Wanda ya yi wa wasu mutane da haske.
Wanda ya samu mai haske da mai jin kalubale.
Yar da ake amfani da shi a 'sense of humor' (sauyoyin wasanni).
Matsayi na halin jiki na wani lokaci.
Da yawa.
Yar da ake amfani da shi don nuna sabon abu ko dalili.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I really admire my sister because she is always honest, even when it's difficult.
dialogue.translation: Ina girma da yaro da nawa saboda ta kasance da haske da yawa, har yaushe da yaushe ba tare da wahala ba.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's great. My best friend is very brave – he once stood up to a bully at school.
dialogue.translation: Wannan da yawa. Abokina mai daraja ya kasance da haske – ya tsallake wani mai tsoro a makaranta baya.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Wow, that takes courage. My sister is also generous and often helps our neighbors with their groceries.
dialogue.translation: Yau da yaushe, wannan ya sa ya yi da haske. Yaro na kuma mai haske da yawa, ta kuma taimaka wa masu jiranmu da kayan asali.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: She sounds kind. My friend is usually patient, but he can get into a bad mood if he's tired.
dialogue.translation: Yaro ya fadi da haske. Abokina ya kasance da haske da yawa, amma ya iya shiga matsayin wahala idan ya yi wahala.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see. My sister is a bit shy at first, but once you know her, she's very friendly.
dialogue.translation: Na gane. Yaro na kuma mai tsoro da yawa a farko, amma bayan ka san ta, ta kasance mai haske da yawa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's nice. My friend has a great sense of humor – he always makes me laugh.
dialogue.translation: Wannan da yawa. Abokina ya kasance da sauyoyin wasanni mai haske – ya kuma sanya ni da haske da yawa.

scenario: Talking about education and learning
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Yin amfani da shi don samun ilimi ko fasaha.
Ayyuka da ke nufin zama da shi don samun ilimi.
Mutum da ke koyarwa.
Mutum da ke jima.
Jerin sabuwar fasaha akan wata matsa.
Yadda wata mataki ko fahimta ta nuna.
Ƙaramin kalma da ke neman bayani.
Biya da amsa ga tambaya.
Gane ma'ana da wata abu.
Kiyaye wata abu a yanzu.
Yin aiki da yawa don sabunta fasaha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need to study more for my English course, but I don't have much time.
dialogue.translation: Ina bukatan jiha da yawa domin kursuwu na Ingilishi, amma ba zan sami lokaci da yawa ba.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Why don't you practice with me every evening? We can learn together.
dialogue.translation: Me ya sa ba ka yi fasaha da ni kowace yammama? Zamu iya ƙwarewa tare.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, but I have a question: do you think our teacher will help us if we don't understand something?
dialogue.translation: Wannan akwai daidai, amma ina da tambaya: ka yarda cewa mahal·li na za shi taimaka mana idan ba mu fahim wata abu ba?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course, our teacher always answers every question with a clear example.
dialogue.translation: Da yaushe, mahal·li na ya aiki da yawa da amsa ga dukkan tambayoyi tare da misali mai haske.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I hope I can remember all the new words we learn.
dialogue.translation: Na fatan in iya yin haske da dukkan kalmomin sabuwar da muka ƙware.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: If you practice daily, you will see that you remember more easily.
dialogue.translation: Idan ka yi fasaha kowace rana, za ka gani cewa ka iya yin haske da sauki.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. Let's start today, and I'll be a better student!
dialogue.translation: Ka yi hakuri. Bude yanzu, zan zama jami'a mai kyau!

key_phrases.phrase: Why don't you practice with me?
key_phrases.translation: Me ya sa ba ka yi fasaha da ni?
Na fatan in iya yin haske

scenario: Discussing a problem and offering solutions
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ya zai da rai da 'matsala'.
Yanzu da yawa ya zama da 'samu' ko 'ba da'.
Da zarar ya bayyana a cikin list na 'yarda', an canza matuƙa: 'yarda da' (yarda da).
A wannan yanayi ya nufi 'wahala', ba 'dutse' ba.
Ya zama da shawara da alheri.
Ya nuna sabon abu ko tsari.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We have a big problem with the schedule for next week.
dialogue.translation: Muna da matsala mai yawa da kallo na wata biyu da wata biyu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I know it's hard, but maybe we can find a solution together.
dialogue.translation: Na san cewa wahala ce, amma kuma zai iya mu samu waɗa tare.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'd like to offer my idea: we could move the meeting to Friday.
dialogue.translation: Na son in ba da ra'ayina: zai iya mu canza taron zuwa ranar Jumma'a.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds easy to do, but will everyone agree on the new time?
dialogue.translation: Wannan ya yi mai sauƙi, amma ko kowa zai yarda da sabon lokaci?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Let's ask them first, and then we can decide what to do.
dialogue.translation: Bari mu tambayi su da farko, sai dai zai iya mu yarda da abin da muke yi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Good plan. Let's do that and solve this problem today.
dialogue.translation: Plen mai kyau ne. Mu yi haka kuma mu cika wannan matsala yau.

scenario: Comparing two options for a trip
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ya zama daidaitawa ne don zabi bayanai.
Verb mai saukin: farashin, farashin, farashin.
Yana nufin lokaci, ba saurin fasaha ba.
Yana nufin kawo wani abu da ka.
Sai da yawa na 'da yawa'.
Yana daidai da bayanin daidaitawa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I can't decide which option to choose for our trip: the bus or the train.
dialogue.translation: Ba zan iya zargi wace matsayi zan zaɓi don yawo na: motar jirgin sama ko jirgin ƙasa ba.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Well, the bus is cheaper than the train, but it's slower.
dialogue.translation: To, motar jirgin ƙasa tana da yawa daga jirgin sama, amma tana da yawa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but the train costs more, and we need to arrive quickly.
dialogue.translation: Da yaushe, jirgin sama ya farashin da yawa, kuma muna buƙatar zuwa daidai.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Also, the train is safer, especially at night.
dialogue.translation: Kuma, jirgin sama yana da lafiya, musamman da dare.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: But the train is more expensive, and we can bring more luggage on the bus.
dialogue.translation: Amma jirgin sama yana da farashin da yawa, kuma muna iya kawo kayan aiki da yawa a cikin motar jirgin ƙasa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's true. So maybe we should take the bus and spend less money.
dialogue.translation: Haka ne. Don haka maybe zan zabi motar jirgin ƙasa kuma zan sarrafa da yawa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, let's go with the bus. We can save money and still have fun.
dialogue.translation: Lafiya, zan zabi motar jirgin ƙasa. Zan iya sarrafa kuɗi kuma zan sami murna.

scenario: Talking about social media habits
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Abin da aka yi da ake amfani da shi a matsayin jimilar (verb) da kuma matsayin wata abu (noun).
Yin amfani da shi a saita da ƙungiyar sadarwa: share wani abu.
Baya wa wani a saita.
Feed shine jerin post da aka duba.
A matsayin noun: 'a like' = wata 'dadi'.
Da kuma a matsayin verb: yin magana.
Yin bayanin da aka yi da intanet.
Yin amfani da shi a saita da tsarin private.
Daidaito da 'private'.
Profile na waka a saita.
Yin bayanin abubuwan da ake yi da yawa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How often do you usually post on social media?
dialogue.translation: Yaushe ka yi post a saita?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I try to share something every day, but sometimes I just scroll through my feed without posting.
dialogue.translation: Ina son in share wani abu kowace rana, amma da yaushe na yi scroll a wani feed ba tare da posting ba.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you follow many people?
dialogue.translation: Kai baya wa mutane da yawa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, but I mostly follow friends and family. I don't like getting too many likes or comments, so I keep my profile private.
dialogue.translation: Ee, amma na baya da yawa abokai da iyaye. Ba zan yarda da 'dadi' da 'magana' da yawa ba, saboda na sa profile na private.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's smart. I have a public profile because I want more people to see my posts.
dialogue.translation: Wannan da ya fi kyau. Ina da profile na jama'a saboda na son mutane da yawa su gani wani post na.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I understand. But being online all the time can be exhausting, so I limit my time.
dialogue.translation: Na fahimci. Amma da yaushe na intanet ya zama mai wahala, saboda na kama lokacina.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. Maybe I should do that too.
dialogue.translation: Kai daidai. Maybe zan yi wannan kuma.

scenario: Giving a short presentation at work
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Yin amfani da shi don fassara wata abu daga cikin wata abu.
Ya nuna abin da ya fi muhimman.
A cikin nishadi, 'main point' shine ma'ana mai muhimmanci.
Yin amfani da shi don wuce zuwa wata fasaha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, let's start. My presentation will include three main parts.
dialogue.translation: Yaushe, mu fara. Nifirina zai iya inkiri fasaha uku masu matsayi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds good. What is your first point?
dialogue.translation: Wannan ya dace. Me ne ma'ana na farko?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The first part is about our sales results from last month.
dialogue.translation: Fasahar da ta farko tana game da sabbin fasalin kasuwanci na wata da ta gabata.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: And what will you cover next?
dialogue.translation: Da me zaka yi bayani zuwa gaba?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Next, I'll talk about our main challenges during that period.
dialogue.translation: Zuwa gaba, zan yi bayani game da matsalolin mu masu muhimmanci da yaushe wannan lokaci.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Will you also mention the new marketing strategy?
dialogue.translation: Kuna iya fassara sabon fasalin fasaha?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, that's an important point, and I'll end with our goals for this month.
dialogue.translation: I, wannan ma'ana mai muhimmanci ne, kuma zan kare da abubuwan da muke son su wannan watan.

scenario: Discussing a sport or hobby you follow
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: A wannan yanayin, yana nufin bayawa da sport ko ko'ina ba da fasaha.
Yana da amfani da wasanni.
Yanzu: yi nasara.
Yanzu: yi rashin nasara.
Zai iya zama suna: wasanni.
Yana da amfani da shi domin tsariyar wasanni.
Yana da amfani da shi a wasanni: wasa da wata tima.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you follow any sport? I'm really into football.
dialogue.translation: Kun bayawa da wasanni? Na son wasanni da yawa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I watch basketball. My favorite team is the Lakers, although they don't win every match.
dialogue.translation: Ee, na ganin basketi. Timin na yatsa shine Lakers, duk da haka ba suyi nasara a dukan wasanni.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: They played against the Celtics last night, right? Who scored the most points?
dialogue.translation: Sun wasa da Celtics da rai, ba? Wane ne ya sake yawa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yeah, but we lost. Their best player had an amazing game.
dialogue.translation: Ee, amma mun yi rashin nasara. Mai wasanni ne ya yi wasanni mai ban tsana.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a shame. Do you think they have a chance in the playoffs this season?
dialogue.translation: Wannan matsala ce. Shin kun yiwa da damar a wasanni na wasanni wannan matsayi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe, but it's hard. Although they have good players, they need to improve their defense.
dialogue.translation: Maybe, amma yana da wahala. Duk da haka suna da masu wasanni masu kyau, amma suke bukata da sabon fasaha.

key_phrases.translation: yi nasara/yi rashin nasara a wasanni
